CA.rationale: Content items are paired with processing-origin entries (command_estimate/history_estimate) for the same referent/time.

COD.rationale: For each binding content (red/blue) is listed alongside an explicit origin/organization entry for the same referent/time, showing content, organization/presentation and status distinctions.

A.rationale: Processing-origin tags (command_estimate, history_estimate, feedback_through) are explicitly associated with the same referents that list content, linking processing conditions to content presentation/access.

C.rationale: Multiple literal entries identify content items and their color attributes at explicit referents/times.

D.rationale: Content listings (red/blue) are presented separately from explicit origin/status fields for the same referents, distinguishing identification from organization/status.

evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

O.rationale: The text states presentation/organizational properties (grid orientation, peaks) and includes explicit origin/organization fields tied to referents.
